title.en: Volume 159 Treatises 112: Selection and Appointment of Officials 5
title.raw: 卷一百五十九 志第一百十二 選舉五 Volume 159 Treatises 112: Selection and Appointment of Officials 5

sentences.zh: 選舉五

translations.literal: Selection and Appointment Five.
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Appointment, Part Five

sentences.zh: 〈（銓法下）〉

translations.literal: (Selection Rules, Part Two)
translations.idiomatic: (Selection Rules, Part Two)

sentences.zh: ○遠州銓補蔭流外補

translations.literal: ○ Distant Prefecture Selection, Privilege Appointments, and Stream-Outside Appointments
translations.idiomatic: Distant Prefecture Selection, Privilege Appointments, and Stream-Outside Appointments

sentences.zh: 川峽、閩、廣，阻遠險惡，中州之人，多不願仕其地。

translations.literal: Sichuan gorges, Fujian, and Guangdong were obstructed, remote, perilous, and harsh; people from the central provinces were largely unwilling to serve in those regions.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan, Fujian, and Guangdong were remote, rugged, and dangerous, and people from the central provinces were generally reluctant to take posts there.

sentences.zh: 初，銓格稍限以法，凡州縣、幕職，每一任近，即一任遠。

translations.literal: Initially, selection regulations were somewhat restricted by law: for all prefectural, county, and staff posts, one term in a nearby post was followed by one in a distant post.
translations.idiomatic: At first, the selection rules required that officials holding prefecture, county, or staff posts serve one term in a nearby jurisdiction before serving one in a distant jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 川峽、廣南及沿邊，不許挈家者為遠，餘悉為近。

translations.literal: Sichuan gorges, southern Guang, and the border regions where families were not permitted were classified as distant; all others were classified as nearby.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan, southern Guang, and border posts where officials could not bring their families were counted as distant appointments; all other posts counted as nearby.

sentences.zh: 既分川峽為四路，廣南東、西為二路，福建一路，後增荊湖南一路，始立八路定差之制，許中州及土著在選者隨意就差，名曰「指射」，行之不廢。

translations.literal: After Sichuan gorges was divided into four circuits, southern Guang into eastern and western circuits, Fujian into one circuit, and later Hunan South into one additional circuit, the system of fixed assignment across the eight circuits was established, permitting those from the central provinces and native elites on the selection rolls to choose their assignments as they wished; this was called "directed assignment," and the practice was not abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Once Sichuan had been divided into four circuits, southern Guang into eastern and western circuits, Fujian into one circuit, and later Hunan South into another, the eight-circuit fixed-assignment system was instituted. Central-province officials and local candidates on the rolls were allowed to choose assignments at will; the practice was called "directed assignment" and remained in force.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，選人孟巒擬賓州錄事參軍，詣匭訴冤，坐流海島。

translations.literal: In the early Taiping Xingguo era, the candidate Meng Luan was slated for Record Officer of Bin Prefecture and, going to the petition box to lodge a grievance of injustice, was sentenced to exile on a distant island.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Taiping Xingguo period, the candidate Meng Luan was assigned as Recorder of Bin Prefecture. He filed a complaint of injustice in the petition box and was banished to a distant island.

sentences.zh: 自是，得遠地者不敢辭。

translations.literal: From then on, those assigned to distant regions did not dare refuse.
translations.idiomatic: After that, officials assigned to distant posts did not dare to decline.

sentences.zh: 既而詔：「川峽、嶺南、福建注授，計程外給兩月期，違則本州不得放上，遣送闕下，除籍不齒。

translations.literal: Subsequently, an edict stated: "For assignments in Sichuan gorges, the Lingnan region, and Fujian, two months beyond travel time are granted; if the deadline is violated, the home prefecture may not release the document; the offender is sent to the capital and struck from the rolls without standing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then stipulated: "Appointees to Sichuan, Lingnan, and Fujian would be allowed two months beyond the calculated travel time; if they failed to comply, their home prefecture could not issue the release document, and they would be sent to the capital and removed from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 或被疾，則所至陳牒，長吏按驗，付以公據；

translations.literal: If illness occurred, a memorial was submitted at the place reached, the prefectural chief verified it, and official certification was issued;
translations.idiomatic: If illness intervened, they were to submit a memorial where they arrived; the local chief would verify it and grant official certification;

sentences.zh: 廢痼末損，則條狀以聞。」

translations.literal: if the chronic illness had improved but not fully healed, the details were memorialized to the throne."
translations.idiomatic: and if a chronic ailment had only partly improved, the particulars were to be reported in a memorial."

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，又詔：「選人年六十，勿注遠地；

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, another edict stated: "Selection candidates aged sixty are not to be assigned to distant regions;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongxi, another edict stated: "Candidates aged sixty are not to be assigned to distant regions;

sentences.zh: 非土人而願者聽。

translations.literal: non-natives who wish to serve there may be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: except that non-natives who wish to serve there may be permitted.

sentences.zh: 凡任廣、蜀、福建州縣，並給續食。」

translations.literal: All who served in prefectures and counties of Guang, Shu, and Fujian were granted continued salary provisions."
translations.idiomatic: All officials serving in prefectures and counties of Guang, Shu, and Fujian were granted continued salary provisions."

sentences.zh: 初，嶺南闕官，往往差攝。

translations.literal: Initially, when Lingnan lacked officials, acting appointments were often made.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Lingnan lacked officials, acting appointments were often made.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔州長吏試可者選用之；

translations.literal: At this time, an edict directed prefectural chiefs to select those who passed examination for appointment;
translations.idiomatic: At this point, an edict directed prefectural chiefs to select those who passed examination for appointment;

sentences.zh: 罷秩，奏送闕下，與出身。

translations.literal: upon completion of term, memorials were sent to the court and initial appointment credentials granted.
translations.idiomatic: and upon completion of their terms, memorials were sent to the court and initial appointment credentials granted.

sentences.zh: 淳化間，又詔：「嶺南攝官，各路惟許選二十員以承乏，餘悉罷歸。」

translations.literal: During the Chunhua period, another edict stated: "Acting officials in Lingnan—each circuit may select only twenty to fill vacancies; all others are dismissed and returned."
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua period, another edict stated: "For acting officials in Lingnan, each circuit may select only twenty to fill vacancies; all others are to be dismissed and sent home."

sentences.zh: 始，令嶺南幕職，許攜族行，受代不得寄留。

translations.literal: Initially, it was ordered that staff officers in Lingnan might bring their families; upon succession they could not remain on leave.
translations.idiomatic: At first, staff officers in Lingnan were permitted to bring their families, but upon succession they could not remain on leave.

sentences.zh: 至道初，申詔：「劍南州縣官，不得以族行。

translations.literal: In the early Zhidao period, an edict was reissued: "Prefecture and county officials in Jiannan may not bring their families.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhidao period, an edict was reissued: "Prefecture and county officials in Jiannan may not bring their families.

sentences.zh: 敢有妄稱妻為女奴，攜以之官，除名。」

translations.literal: Anyone who falsely claims his wife is a female slave and takes her to his post shall be removed from office."
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who falsely claims his wife is a female slave and takes her to his post shall be removed from office."

sentences.zh: 初，榮州司理判官鄭蛟，冒禁攜妻之任。

translations.literal: Initially, Zheng Jiao, judicial assistant of Rong Prefecture, violated the prohibition by taking his wife to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zheng Jiao, judicial assistant of Rong Prefecture, had violated the prohibition by taking his wife to his post.

sentences.zh: 會蜀賊李順構亂，其黨田子宣攻陷城邑，而蛟捕得之，擢為推官。

translations.literal: When the Shu bandit Li Shun raised rebellion and his follower Tian Zixuan captured cities and towns, Jiao captured him and was promoted to investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shu rebel Li Shun raised an uprising and his follower Tian Zixuan captured cities and towns, Jiao captured him and was promoted to investigating officer.

sentences.zh: 至是，知梓州張雍奏其事，上命戮蛟，而有是詔。

translations.literal: At this time Zhang Yong, prefect of Zizhou, memorialized the matter; the emperor ordered Jiao executed, and this edict followed.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Zhang Yong, prefect of Zizhou, memorialized the matter; the emperor ordered Jiao executed, and this edict followed.

sentences.zh: 咸平間，以新、恩、循、梅四州瘴地，選荊湖、福建人注之。

translations.literal: During the Xianping period, the malarial prefectures of Xin, En, Xun, and Mei had candidates from Huguang and Fujian assigned.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianping period, the malarial prefectures of Xin, En, Xun, and Mei were assigned candidates from Huguang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 吏部銓擬官，悉標其過犯，自是，凡注惡地，令不須書。

translations.literal: When the Ministry of Personnel proposed appointments, it marked all past offenses; thereafter, for assignments to undesirable regions, it was ordered that offenses need not be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ministry of Personnel proposed appointments, it marked all past offenses on the record; thereafter, for assignments to undesirable regions, it was ordered that offenses need not be noted.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「規避遐遠，違期受代，勘鞫責罰，就移遠地。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Those who evade distant posts and violate deadlines for succession, upon investigation shall be punished and transferred to distant regions."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Those who evade distant posts or violate deadlines for succession shall, upon investigation, be punished and transferred to distant regions."

sentences.zh: 神宗更製，始詔：「川峽、福建、廣南，之官罷任，迎送勞苦，其令轉運司立格就注，免其赴選。」

translations.literal: Under Shenzong's reforms, an edict was first issued: "For Sichuan gorges, Fujian, and southern Guang, the hardship of escort upon arrival and departure at the end of term—the transport commissioners shall establish regulations for local assignment, exempting them from going to selection."
translations.idiomatic: Under Shenzong's reforms, an edict was first issued: "For Sichuan, Fujian, and southern Guang, the hardship of escort upon arrival and departure at the end of a term is great; transport commissioners shall establish regulations for local assignment and exempt officials from going to the capital for selection."

sentences.zh: 於是七路自常選知州而下，轉運司置員闕籍，具書應代時日，下所部郡眾示之。

translations.literal: Thereupon, in the seven circuits from regular-selection prefects downward, transport commissioners established vacancy registers, recording scheduled succession dates, and posted them throughout the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, in the seven circuits, from regularly selected prefects downward, transport commissioners established vacancy registers, recorded scheduled succession dates, and posted them throughout the prefectures under their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 凡見任距受代半年及已終更者，許用本資序指射。

translations.literal: All incumbents within six months of succession and those who had completed their terms were permitted to use their original rank sequence for directed assignment.
translations.idiomatic: All incumbents within six months of succession and those who had completed their terms were permitted to use their original rank sequence for directed assignment.

sentences.zh: 有司受而閱之，定其應格當差者，上之審官東院、流內銓，審覆如令，即奏聞降敕。

translations.literal: The relevant offices received and reviewed them, determined those meeting requirements for assignment, sent them to the Eastern Review Office and the Outside Stream Selection Board; upon review in accordance with regulations, memorials were submitted and edicts issued.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices received and reviewed the applications, determined those who met the requirements for assignment, and sent them to the Eastern Review Office and the Outside Stream Selection Board; upon review in accordance with regulations, memorials were submitted and edicts issued.

sentences.zh: 若占籍本路，或遊注此州，皆從其便；

translations.literal: If registered in the home circuit, or temporarily assigned in this prefecture, convenience was permitted;
translations.idiomatic: If registered in the home circuit or temporarily assigned in a given prefecture, convenience was permitted;

sentences.zh: 惟不許官本貫州縣及鄰境，其參擬銓次悉如銓格。

translations.literal: only assignment to one's native prefecture, county, or neighboring jurisdiction was forbidden; the proposed selection order followed selection regulations entirely.
translations.idiomatic: only assignment to one's native prefecture, county, or neighboring jurisdiction was forbidden; the proposed selection order followed the selection regulations entirely.

sentences.zh: 無願注者，上其闕審官，而在選者射之。

translations.literal: If none wished assignment, the vacancy was sent to the review office and those on the selection rolls could bid for it.
translations.idiomatic: If no one wished the assignment, the vacancy was sent to the review office and those on the selection rolls could bid for it.

sentences.zh: 武臣之屬西院、三班院者，令樞密院放此具製。

translations.literal: For military officers under the Western Court and Third-Class Court, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to prepare regulations likewise.
translations.idiomatic: For military officers under the Western Court and Third-Class Court, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to prepare regulations on the same model.

sentences.zh: 後荊湖南亦許就注。

translations.literal: Later Hunan South was also permitted local assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Hunan South was also permitted local assignment.

sentences.zh: 或言：「土人知州非便。

translations.literal: Someone stated: "Native prefects are inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Someone stated: "It is inappropriate for natives to serve as prefects.

sentences.zh: 法應遠近迭居，而川人許連任本路，常獲家便，實太偏濫。」

translations.literal: By law, near and distant posts should alternate, yet Sichuan natives are permitted consecutive terms in their home circuit, constantly enjoying familial convenience—this is truly excessively lenient."
translations.idiomatic: By law, near and distant posts should alternate, yet Sichuan natives are permitted consecutive terms in their home circuit and constantly enjoy familial convenience—this is truly excessively lenient."

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：「分遠近，均勞佚也。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "Distinguishing near and distant equals labor and rest.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said: "Distinguishing near and distant posts is meant to equalize labor and rest.

sentences.zh: 中州士不願適遠，四路人樂就家便，用新法即兩得所欲；

translations.literal: Central-province scholars are unwilling to go to distant regions; people of the four circuits gladly take posts convenient to home—with the new law both get what they desire;
translations.idiomatic: Central-province scholars are unwilling to go to distant regions, while people of the four circuits gladly take posts convenient to home; under the new law both sides get what they want;

sentences.zh: 況可以省吏卒將迎、官府浮費邪？」

translations.literal: moreover, cannot this save the expense of clerks and soldiers for escort and governmental overhead?"
translations.idiomatic: and besides, can this not save the expense of clerks and soldiers for escort and other governmental overhead?"

sentences.zh: 何正臣又言：「蜀人之在仕籍者特眾，今自郡守而下皆得就差，一郡之官，土人太半，寮寀吏民皆其鄉里親信，難於徇公，易以合黨。

translations.literal: He Zhenchen also stated: "Among those from Shu on the service rolls the number is especially great; now from prefects downward all may be locally assigned—a prefecture's officials are more than half natives; colleagues, retainers, clerks, and people are all their hometown kin and trusted associates, difficult to act impartially, easy to form factions.
translations.idiomatic: He Zhenchen also stated: "The number of Shu natives on the service rolls is especially great; now from prefects downward all may be locally assigned, so that more than half of a prefecture's officials are natives. Their colleagues, retainers, clerks, and common people are all hometown kin and trusted associates—making impartiality difficult and faction-forming easy.

sentences.zh: 請收守令闕歸之朝廷，而他官兼用土人，量立分限，庶經久無弊。

translations.literal: Please return prefect and magistrate vacancies to the court, while other posts may partly use natives within set limits, so that in the long run there will be no abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Please return prefect and magistrate vacancies to the court, while other posts may partly use natives within set limits, so that in the long run there will be no abuse.

sentences.zh: 兼聞差注未至盡公，願許提刑司索案牘究察之。」

translations.literal: I also hear that assignments have not been entirely fair; please permit the judicial intendant to request case files for investigation."
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that assignments have not been entirely fair; please permit the judicial intendant to request case files for investigation."

sentences.zh: 奏上，法不為改，但申嚴提刑司互察之法。

translations.literal: Upon memorial submission, the law was not changed, but only the mutual inspection regulations for judicial intendants were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the law was not changed, but only the mutual inspection regulations for judicial intendants were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，御史上官均言：「定差不均之弊有七：諸路赴選中試乃差，八路隨意取射，一也。

translations.literal: In the early Yuanyou period, memorializing censor Shangguan Jun stated: "The abuses of uneven fixed assignment are seven: Other circuits must pass central selection examination before assignment; the eight circuits may freely bid for assignment—that is the first.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yuanyou period, memorializing censor Shangguan Jun stated: "The abuses of uneven fixed assignment are seven. First, other circuits must pass the central selection examination before assignment, while the eight circuits may freely bid for assignment.

sentences.zh: 諸路吏部待試，需次率及七年，方成一任；

translations.literal: In other circuits the Ministry of Personnel awaits examination; waiting for turn generally takes seven years before one term is completed;
translations.idiomatic: In other circuits, candidates await examination at the Ministry of Personnel, and waiting for turn generally takes seven years before one term is completed;

sentences.zh: 八路就注，若及七年，已更三任，二也。

translations.literal: in the eight circuits with local assignment, if seven years elapse, three terms have already been completed—that is the second.
translations.idiomatic: in the eight circuits with local assignment, if seven years elapse, three terms have already been completed—that is the second.

sentences.zh: 八路雖坐停罷，隨許射注；

translations.literal: Though the eight circuits may be suspended from office, directed assignment is still permitted;
translations.idiomatic: Though officials in the eight circuits may be suspended from office, directed assignment is still permitted;

sentences.zh: 而見在吏部待次之人，至有曆任無過，尚須試法，候及一年方有注擬，三也。

translations.literal: yet persons awaiting turn at the Ministry of Personnel, even with faultless service across terms, must still take the examination method and wait a full year before appointment proposal—that is the third.
translations.idiomatic: yet persons awaiting turn at the Ministry of Personnel, even with faultless service across several terms, must still take the examination and wait a full year before appointment proposal—that is the third.

sentences.zh: 其待次者又許權攝，祿無虛日；

translations.literal: Those awaiting turn are also permitted temporary acting appointment with salary without idle days;
translations.idiomatic: Those awaiting turn are also permitted temporary acting appointment and receive salary without idle days;

sentences.zh: 而吏選無愆犯，亦大率四年方再得祿，四也。

translations.literal: yet Ministry candidates without violations generally take four years before receiving salary again—that is the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: yet Ministry candidates without violations generally wait four years before receiving salary again—that is the fourth.

sentences.zh: 土人得射奏名者，免試就注家便，年高力憊，不復望進，往往營私廢職，五也。

translations.literal: Natives who bid and receive named appointment are exempt from examination and assigned near home; aged and enfeebled, no longer hoping for advancement, they often seek private gain and neglect duty—that is the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Natives who bid and receive named appointment are exempt from examination and assigned near home; aged and enfeebled, no longer hoping for advancement, they often seek private gain and neglect duty—that is the fifth.

sentences.zh: 仕久知識既多，土人就射本路，不無親故請托，六也。

translations.literal: After long service with many connections, natives bidding for assignment in their home circuit inevitably involve kin and acquaintances pulling strings—that is the sixth.
translations.idiomatic: After long service with many connections, natives bidding for assignment in their home circuit inevitably involve kin and acquaintances pulling strings—that is the sixth.

sentences.zh: 八路監司地遠而專，設漫滅功過名次，人亦不敢爭校；

translations.literal: Eight-circuit supervising commissioners are distant and autonomous; if they carelessly alter merit and demerit rankings, people also dare not dispute;
translations.idiomatic: Eight-circuit supervising commissioners are distant and autonomous; if they carelessly alter merit and demerit rankings, people also dare not dispute;

sentences.zh: 故有力者多得優便，而孤寒滯卻，七也。

translations.literal: thus the powerful often obtain favorable posts while the isolated and poor are held back—that is the seventh.
translations.idiomatic: thus the powerful often obtain favorable posts while the isolated and poor are held back—that is the seventh.

sentences.zh: 請並八路差盡歸吏部為便。」

translations.literal: Please return all eight-circuit assignments entirely to the Ministry of Personnel for convenience."
translations.idiomatic: Please return all eight-circuit assignments entirely to the Ministry of Personnel for convenience."

sentences.zh: 既而吏部亦請用常格差除，遂悉歸之銓。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ministry of Personnel also requested using regular regulations for assignment and removal; all were returned to the selection boards.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Ministry of Personnel also requested using regular regulations for assignment and removal, and all assignments were returned to the selection boards.

sentences.zh: 紹聖復行舊制，且許八路人蔭補出官，即轉運司試中注闕。

translations.literal: In Shaosheng the old system was restored, and natives of the eight circuits with privilege appointments entering office were directly assigned vacancies upon passing transport commissioner examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng the old system was restored, and natives of the eight circuits entering office through privilege appointment were directly assigned vacancies upon passing transport commissioner examination.

sentences.zh: 重和間，臣僚又言其弊：「轉運以軍儲、吏祿、供饋、支移為己責，而視差注為末務，往往付之主案吏胥定擬，而簽廳視成書判而已。

translations.literal: During the Chonghe period, officials again spoke of its abuses: "Transport commissioners regard military supplies, clerical salaries, tribute, and transfer disbursements as their own responsibility, while treating assignment as a minor matter, often leaving proposed appointments to chief clerks to determine, merely signing completed drafts.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chonghe period, officials again spoke of its abuses: "Transport commissioners regard military supplies, clerical salaries, tribute, and transfer disbursements as their own responsibility, while treating assignment as a minor matter, often leaving proposed appointments to chief clerks to determine and merely signing completed drafts.

sentences.zh: 注闕之高下，視賄之厚薄。

translations.literal: Whether vacancies were high or low depended on the thickness of bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Whether vacancies were high or low depended on the thickness of bribes.

sentences.zh: 無賂，則定差之牘，脫漏言詞，隱落節目。

translations.literal: Without bribes, the fixed-assignment documents would have omitted words and dropped sections.
translations.idiomatic: Without bribes, the fixed-assignment documents would have omitted words and dropped sections.

sentences.zh: 及其上部，必致退卻，參會重上，又半歲矣。

translations.literal: When submitted to higher authority they were inevitably rejected; re-memorialized and resubmitted, another half year passed.
translations.idiomatic: When submitted to higher authority they were inevitably rejected; re-memorialized and resubmitted, another half year passed.

sentences.zh: 以是闕多而不調者眾。

translations.literal: Thus many vacancies went unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Thus many vacancies went unfilled.

sentences.zh: 宜督典領之官，歲終取吏部退難有無、多寡，為之課而賞罰之，庶可公注擬而絕吏賕。」

translations.literal: Supervisory officials should be charged; at year's end tally Ministry rejections by presence and quantity for performance assessment with rewards and punishments, so assignments may be fair and clerical bribery eliminated."
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory officials should be charged; at year's end tally Ministry rejections by presence and quantity for performance assessment with rewards and punishments, so assignments may be fair and clerical bribery eliminated."

sentences.zh: 乃命立《考課法》。

translations.literal: The 《Examination Law》 was ordered established.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Examination Law》 was then ordered established.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，詔福建、二廣闕並歸吏部，惟四川仍舊制。

translations.literal: In the early Jianyan period, an edict returned Fujian and the two Guang vacancies to the Ministry of Personnel; only Sichuan retained the old system.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Jianyan period, an edict returned Fujian and the two Guang vacancies to the Ministry of Personnel; only Sichuan retained the old system.

sentences.zh: 初，累朝以廣南地遠，利入不足以資正官，故使舉人兩與薦選者，試刑法於漕司，以合格者注攝兩路，謂之「待次」。

translations.idiomatic: Those who had once been convicted of corruption could recover their former offices.

sentences.zh: 文臣至郎中及員外郎任館閣職，武臣至諸司副使、諸衛將軍者，止許蔭子若孫一人，尚在謫籍者弗預。

translations.literal: Civil officials reaching Director or Vice Director rank holding Hall of Literature posts, and military officials reaching vice commissioner of a bureau or general of the guards rank, were permitted to grant privilege appointment to one son or grandson only; those still on the demotion rolls were excluded.
translations.idiomatic: Civil officials reaching Director or Vice Director rank while holding Hall of Literature posts, and military officials reaching vice commissioner of a bureau or general of the guards rank, were permitted to grant privilege appointment to one son or grandson only; those still on the demotion rolls were excluded.

sentences.zh: 太祖初定任子之法，台省六品、諸司五品，登朝嘗曆兩任，然後得請。

translations.literal: When Taizu first established the regulations for appointing sons, officials of sixth rank in the Censorate and Secretariat and fifth rank in the various bureaus who had attended court and served two terms could then petition.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu first established the regulations for appointing sons, officials of sixth rank in the Censorate and Secretariat and fifth rank in the various bureaus who had attended court and completed two terms could then petition.

sentences.zh: 始減歲補千牛、齋郎員額；

translations.literal: The annual quota for Thousand-Ox Guard and Temple Attendant appointments was first reduced;
translations.idiomatic: The annual quota for Thousand-Ox Guard and Temple Attendant appointments was first reduced;

sentences.zh: 齋郎須年貌合格，誦書精熟，乃得奏。

translations.literal: Temple Attendants had to meet age and appearance requirements and recite texts with proficiency before memorializing was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Temple Attendants had to meet age and appearance requirements and recite texts with proficiency before memorializing was permitted.

sentences.zh: 太宗踐極，諸州進奏者授以試銜及三班職，初推恩授散試官者，不得赴選。

translations.literal: When Taizong ascended the throne, memorial presenters from the prefectures were granted trial rank and Third Class posts; those first receiving provisional trial offices through general amnesty were not permitted to go to selection.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, memorial presenters from the prefectures were granted trial rank and Third Class posts; those first receiving provisional trial offices through general amnesty were not permitted to go to selection.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，乃詔授試銜等人特定七選集，遂為定令。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict designated seven selection assemblies for those granted trial rank and the like, and this became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict designated seven selection assemblies for those granted trial rank and the like, and this became fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 凡誕聖節及三年大祀，皆聽奏一人。

translations.literal: For all imperial birthdays and triennial great sacrifices, one person was permitted to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: For all imperial birthdays and triennial great sacrifices, one person was permitted to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 而淳化改元恩，文班中書舍人、武班大將軍以上，並許蔭補；

translations.literal: At the Chunhua reign-change amnesty, civil officials from Secretariat Drafter upward and military officials from General upward were all permitted privilege appointment;
translations.idiomatic: At the Chunhua reign-change amnesty, civil officials from Secretariat Drafter upward and military officials from General upward were all permitted privilege appointment;

sentences.zh: 如遇轉品，許更蔭一子，由是奏薦之恩始廣。

translations.literal: if upon rank promotion, one additional son was permitted privilege appointment; from this the favor of memorial recommendation began to broaden.
translations.idiomatic: and if upon rank promotion one additional son was permitted privilege appointment; from this the favor of memorial recommendation began to broaden.

sentences.zh: 每誕聖節，朝臣多請奏疏屬，不報。

translations.literal: At each imperial birthday, court officials often requested to memorialize distant relatives; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: At each imperial birthday, court officials often requested to memorialize distant relatives, but no response was given.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，始限以翰林學士、兩省五品、尚書省四品以上，賜一子出身，此聖節奏薦例也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao, it was first limited to Hanlin Academicians, fifth-rank officials of the Two Departments, and fourth-rank officials of the Ministry of Personnel and above, granting one son initial appointment credentials—this was the precedent for imperial birthday memorial recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhidao, it was first limited to Hanlin Academicians, fifth-rank officials of the Two Departments, and fourth-rank officials of the Ministry of Personnel and above, granting one son initial appointment credentials—this was the precedent for imperial birthday memorial recommendation.

sentences.zh: 先是，任子得攝太祝、奉禮，未幾即補正員。

translations.literal: Previously, sons appointed by privilege could serve acting as Senior Sacrificer or Court Gentleman for Court Ceremonies and soon after be appointed to regular posts.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, sons appointed by privilege could serve acting as Senior Sacrificer or Court Gentleman for Court Ceremonies and soon after be appointed to regular posts.

sentences.zh: 帝謂：「膏粱之子，不十年坐致閨籍。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Sons of the privileged elite, in less than ten years sitting attain court rank."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Sons of the privileged elite can attain court rank in less than ten years without effort."

sentences.zh: 是年，悉授同學究出身赴選集。

translations.literal: That year, all were granted Student Investigator initial credentials and sent to selection assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: That year, all were granted Student Investigator initial credentials and sent to selection assemblies.

sentences.zh: 真宗東封，祀汾陰，進奉人已官者進秩，未官者令翰林試藝，與試銜、齋郎、借職。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong performed the eastern feng sacrifice and sacrificed at Fenyin, tribute presenters already holding office received rank promotion; those without office were ordered examined in arts by the Hanlin Academy and granted trial rank, Temple Attendant, or Borrowed Rank.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong performed the eastern feng sacrifice and sacrificed at Fenyin, tribute presenters already holding office received rank promotion; those without office were examined in arts by the Hanlin Academy and granted trial rank, Temple Attendant, or Borrowed Rank.

sentences.zh: 公主、郡縣主以下諸親，外命婦入內者，亦有恩慶。

translations.literal: Princesses, commandery and county princesses, and other relatives below them, and outer-court ladies entering the inner palace, also received amnesty favors.
translations.idiomatic: Princesses, commandery and county princesses, and other relatives below them, as well as outer-court ladies entering the inner palace, also received amnesty favors.

sentences.zh: 而東封恩，則提點刑獄、朝臣、使臣，皆得奏一人。

translations.literal: At the eastern feng amnesty, judicial intendants, court officials, and envoys were all permitted to memorialize one person.
translations.idiomatic: At the eastern feng amnesty, judicial intendants, court officials, and envoys were all permitted to memorialize one person.

sentences.zh: 奏戚屬，舊無定制。

translations.literal: Memorializing relatives had no fixed regulation in the past.
translations.idiomatic: Memorializing relatives had no fixed regulation in the past.

sentences.zh: 有求補閣門祗候者，真宗以宣讚之職，非可以恩澤授，乃詔：「自今求敘遷者，至殿直止。」

translations.literal: When someone sought appointment as gate attendant, Zhenzong because the post of imperial announcer could not be granted by favor, issued an edict: "From now on those seeking sequential promotion may rise only to Palace Guard."
translations.idiomatic: When someone sought appointment as gate attendant, Zhenzong held that the post of imperial announcer could not be granted by favor and issued an edict: "From now on those seeking sequential promotion may rise only to Palace Guard."

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，以門蔭授京官，年二十五以上求差使者，令於國學受業，及二年，審官院與判監官考試其業，乃以名聞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, those granted capital official posts through privilege appointment aged twenty-five and above seeking dispatch, were ordered to study at the National University; after two years the Review Office and supervising officials examined their work, and then their names were reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, those aged twenty-five and above who had received capital official posts through privilege appointment and sought dispatch were ordered to study at the National University; after two years the Review Office and supervising officials examined their work, and then their names were reported.

sentences.zh: 內諸司使、副授邊任官者，陛辭時許奏子。

translations.literal: Commissioners and vice commissioners of the inner bureaus granted border posts were permitted to memorialize sons at farewell audience.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners and vice commissioners of the inner bureaus granted border posts were permitted to memorialize sons at farewell audience.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院定其制，凡妄名孫及從子為子求蔭者，坐之。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to establish regulations; all who falsely named grandsons or nephews' sons as sons to seek privilege appointment were punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to establish regulations; all who falsely named grandsons or nephews' sons as sons to seek privilege appointment were punished.

sentences.zh: 七年，帝幸南京，詔臣僚逮事太祖者，賜一子恩澤，令翰林學士李維等定，自給諫、觀察使以上得請。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the emperor visited Nanjing, an edict granted one son favor to officials who had served Taizu; Hanlin Academician Li Wei and others were ordered to establish regulations, from Remonstrance Official and Observation Commissioner upward being permitted to petition.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the emperor visited Nanjing, an edict granted one son favor to officials who had served Taizu; Hanlin Academician Li Wei and others were ordered to establish regulations, from Remonstrance Official and Observation Commissioner upward being permitted to petition.

sentences.zh: 初，轉運使辭日，許奏一人。

translations.literal: Initially, on the day of farewell, transport commissioners were permitted to memorialize one person.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, on the day of farewell, transport commissioners were permitted to memorialize one person.

sentences.zh: 天禧後，惟川、廣、福建者聽，餘路再任始得奏。

translations.literal: After Tianxi, only those in Sichuan, Guang, and Fujian were permitted; other circuits required a second term before memorializing.
translations.idiomatic: After Tianxi, only those in Sichuan, Guang, and Fujian were permitted; other circuits required a second term before memorializing.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「承天節恩例所蔭子孫，不許以他親及已食錄者。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "For descendants granted privilege under the Chengtian Festival amnesty precedent, other relatives and those already receiving salary registers are not permitted."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "For descendants granted privilege under the Chengtian Festival amnesty precedent, other relatives and those already receiving salary registers are not permitted."

sentences.zh: 特許西京分司官，郊禋奏蔭一子。

translations.literal: Western Capital branch officials were specially permitted to memorialize one son for privilege at suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Western Capital branch officials were specially permitted to memorialize one son for privilege at suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自是分務西洛者得以為例，南京則否。

translations.literal: From this those serving separately in western Luoyang could take it as precedent; Nanjing could not.
translations.idiomatic: From this those serving separately in western Luoyang could take it as precedent; Nanjing could not.

sentences.zh: 仁宗慶曆中，裁損奏補入仕之路，凡選人遇郊赴銓試，其不赴試亦無舉者，永不預選。

translations.literal: During Renzong's Qingli period, the path of memorial recommendation into office was curtailed; all selection candidates who at suburban sacrifice went to selection examination—those who did not attend examination and had no recommender were never again permitted in selection.
translations.idiomatic: During Renzong's Qingli period, the path of memorial recommendation into office was curtailed; selection candidates who at suburban sacrifice went to selection examination—those who did not attend examination and had no recommender were never again permitted in selection.

sentences.zh: 罷聖節奏蔭恩，學士以下，遇效恩得奏大功以上親，再遇郊得奏小功以下親。

translations.literal: Imperial birthday memorial privilege was abolished; below Academician rank, upon effective amnesty one could memorialize relatives of second mourning degree or closer; upon a second suburban sacrifice one could memorialize relatives of third mourning degree or more distant.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial birthday memorial privilege was abolished; below Academician rank, upon effective amnesty one could memorialize relatives of second mourning degree or closer; upon a second suburban sacrifice one could memorialize relatives of third mourning degree or more distant.

sentences.zh: 郎中、帶職員外郎，初遇郊蔭子若孫，再郊及期親，四遇郊聽蔭大功以下親。

translations.literal: Directors and Vice Directors with concurrent posts, at first suburban sacrifice granted privilege to son or grandson; at second suburban sacrifice and personal relatives; at fourth suburban sacrifice permitted privilege to relatives of second mourning degree or more distant.
translations.idiomatic: Directors and Vice Directors with concurrent posts, at first suburban sacrifice granted privilege to son or grandson; at second suburban sacrifice to personal relatives; at fourth suburban sacrifice permitted privilege to relatives of second mourning degree or more distant.

sentences.zh: 初得奏而年過六十無子孫，蔭期親。

translations.literal: Those first permitted to memorialize who were over sixty without sons or grandsons granted privilege to personal relatives.
translations.idiomatic: Those first permitted to memorialize who were over sixty without sons or grandsons granted privilege to personal relatives.

sentences.zh: 其皇親大將軍以上妻，再遇郊亦許之。

translations.literal: Wives of imperial relatives of Great General rank and above, at second suburban sacrifice were also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wives of imperial relatives of Great General rank and above were also permitted at second suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 武臣蔭例倣此。

translations.literal: Military officials' privilege precedents followed this model.
translations.idiomatic: Military officials' privilege precedents followed this model.

sentences.zh: 凡蔭長子孫皆不限年，諸子孫須年過十五；

translations.literal: For all privilege appointments, eldest sons and grandsons had no age limit; other sons and grandsons had to be over fifteen;
translations.idiomatic: For all privilege appointments, eldest sons and grandsons had no age limit; other sons and grandsons had to be over fifteen;

sentences.zh: 若弟侄須過二十，必五服親乃許。

translations.literal: younger brothers and nephews had to be over twenty; only five-mourning-degree relatives were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: younger brothers and nephews had to be over twenty; only five-mourning-degree relatives were permitted.

sentences.zh: 已嘗蔭而物故者，無子孫祿仕，聽再蔭。

translations.literal: Those who had once received privilege appointment but died, with no sons or grandsons receiving salary office, were permitted a second privilege appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had once received privilege appointment but died, with no sons or grandsons receiving salaried office, were permitted a second privilege appointment.

sentences.zh: 自是，任子之恩殺矣。

translations.literal: From this, the favor of appointing sons was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: From this, the favor of appointing sons was greatly reduced.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，郡縣致貢奉人，悉命以官。

translations.literal: When Yingzong ascended the throne, tribute presenters from prefectures and counties were all ordered granted office.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong ascended the throne, tribute presenters from prefectures and counties were all ordered granted office.

sentences.zh: 知諫院司馬光建言：「監司、太守，遣親屬奉表京師，不問官職高下、親屬近遠，推恩至班行、幕職、權知州軍，或所遣非親，亦除齋郎及差使、殿侍，此蓋國初承五代姑息藩鎮之弊，因循不革。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Bureau Director Sima Guang submitted a proposal: "Supervising commissioners and prefects send relatives to present memorials to the capital; regardless of official rank high or low or nearness or distance of kin, favor extends to court rank, staff posts, and acting prefectural and military command; or those sent are not kin, yet still receive Temple Attendant, dispatch agent, or palace attendant appointments—this surely inherits the early dynasty's acceptance of the Five Dynasties' indulgence of military governors, continuing uncorrected.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Bureau Director Sima Guang submitted a proposal: "Supervising commissioners and prefects send relatives to present memorials to the capital; regardless of official rank or nearness of kin, favor extends to court rank, staff posts, and acting prefectural and military command; or those sent are not kin, yet still receive Temple Attendant, dispatch agent, or palace attendant appointments—this surely inherits the early dynasty's acceptance of the Five Dynasties' indulgence of military governors, continuing uncorrected.

sentences.zh: 爵錄本待賢才，今此等受官，誠為大濫。

translations.literal: Rank and salary originally awaited talented persons; now such persons receiving office is truly greatly excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Rank and salary originally awaited talented persons; now such persons receiving office is truly greatly excessive.

sentences.zh: 縱不能盡罷其人，若五服內親，等第受以一官，其無服屬量賜金帛，庶少救濫官之失。」

translations.literal: Even if these persons cannot all be dismissed, if relatives within five mourning degrees receive one office by graded rank, and those without mourning ties receive measured gifts of gold and silk, perhaps the error of excessive officeholding can be somewhat remedied."
translations.idiomatic: Even if these persons cannot all be dismissed, if relatives within five mourning degrees receive one office by graded rank, and those without mourning ties receive measured gifts of gold and silk, perhaps the error of excessive officeholding can be somewhat remedied."

sentences.zh: 然詔令已行，不從其議。

translations.literal: However, the edict had already been issued and his proposal was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: However, the edict had already been issued and his proposal was not followed.

sentences.zh: 時方患官冗，言者皆謂：「由三歲一磨勘，其進甚亟，易至高位，故獲蔭者眾。」

translations.literal: At the time there was concern about official redundancy; commentators all said: "Because of triennial merit review, advancement is very rapid and easy to reach high rank, therefore those receiving privilege appointment are numerous."
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was concern about official redundancy; commentators all said: "Because of triennial merit review, advancement is very rapid and easy to reach high rank, therefore those receiving privilege appointment are numerous."

sentences.zh: 乃令待制以上，自遷官後六歲，無故則復遷之，有過益展年，至諫議大夫止。

translations.literal: Thereupon Attendant Academicians and above, six years after rank promotion, if without cause were promoted again; if with fault the years were extended, up to Remonstrance Official only.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Attendant Academicians and above were, six years after rank promotion, promoted again if without cause; if at fault the interval was extended, up to Remonstrance Official only.

sentences.zh: 京朝官四歲磨勘，至前行郎中止，少卿、監限七十員，員有闕，以前行郎中久次者補之。

translations.literal: Capital court officials received merit review every four years, up to Senior Forward Director only; junior directors and supervisors were limited to seventy posts; when a post was vacant, the longest-serving former Senior Forward Director filled it.
translations.idiomatic: Capital court officials received merit review every four years, up to Senior Forward Director only; junior directors and supervisors were limited to seventy posts, and when a post was vacant the longest-serving former Senior Forward Director filled it.

sentences.zh: 少卿、監以上遷官，聽旨。

translations.literal: Promotion of junior directors, supervisors, and above awaited imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion of junior directors, supervisors, and above awaited imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 仁宗雖罷聖節恩，而猶行之妃、主。

translations.literal: Although Renzong abolished imperial birthday favor, he still applied it to consorts and princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Although Renzong abolished imperial birthday favor, he still applied it to consorts and princesses.

sentences.zh: 神宗既裁損臣僚奏蔭，以宮掖外戚恩尤濫，故稍抑之。

translations.literal: After Shenzong curtailed officials' memorial privilege appointments, because favor to palace women and maternal kin was especially excessive, he therefore slightly restrained it.
translations.idiomatic: After Shenzong curtailed officials' memorial privilege appointments, he slightly restrained favor to palace women and maternal kin, which had been especially excessive.

sentences.zh: 舊，諸妃遇聖節奏親屬一人，間一年許奏二人，郊禮許奏一人。

translations.literal: Formerly, all consorts at imperial birthday memorialized one relative; every other year two were permitted; at suburban sacrifice one was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, all consorts at imperial birthday memorialized one relative; every other year two were permitted; and at suburban sacrifice one was permitted.

sentences.zh: 嬪御每遇郊奏一人，兩遇聖節與一奏。

translations.literal: Palace women at each suburban sacrifice memorialized one person; at two imperial birthdays equaled one memorialization.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women memorialized one person at each suburban sacrifice, and two imperial birthdays counted as one memorialization.

sentences.zh: 後定，諸妃每遇聖節並郊許奏有服親一人。

translations.literal: Later it was fixed that all consorts at each imperial birthday and suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative within mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was fixed that all consorts at each imperial birthday and suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative within mourning.

sentences.zh: 淑儀、充儀、婕妤、貴人遇郊，許奏小功以上親一人，位號別而資品同者，許比類奏薦。

translations.literal: Graceful Conduct, Full Conduct, Talented Lady, and Noble Lady at suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative of third mourning degree or closer; those of different titles but equal salary rank were permitted analogous memorial recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Graceful Conduct, Full Conduct, Talented Lady, and Noble Lady at suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative of third mourning degree or closer; those of different titles but equal salary rank were permitted analogous memorial recommendation.

sentences.zh: 舊，公主每遇聖節、郊禮，奏夫之親屬一人；

translations.literal: Formerly, princesses at each imperial birthday and suburban sacrifice memorialized one of the husband's relatives;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, princesses at each imperial birthday and suburban sacrifice memorialized one of the husband's relatives;

sentences.zh: 公主生日，許奏一人。

translations.literal: at a princess's birthday, one person was permitted to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: and at a princess's birthday one person was permitted to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 後罷生日恩，所奏須有服親。

translations.literal: Later birthday favor was abolished; memorializations had to be relatives within mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Later birthday favor was abolished, and memorializations had to be relatives within mourning.

sentences.zh: 皇親妻兩遇郊，許奏期親一人，後罷奏。

translations.literal: Wives of imperial relatives at two suburban sacrifices were permitted to memorialize one personal relative; later memorialization was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Wives of imperial relatives at two suburban sacrifices were permitted to memorialize one personal relative; later memorialization was abolished.

sentences.zh: 舊，郡、縣主遇郊，許奏親生子右班殿直，若庶子及其夫之親，兩遇郊許奏借職一人。

translations.literal: Formerly, commandery and county princesses at suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize sons born of the principal wife as Right Class Palace Guard; for sons by concubines and the husband's kin, at two suburban sacrifices one Borrowed Rank was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, commandery and county princesses at suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize sons born of the principal wife as Right Class Palace Guard; for sons by concubines and the husband's kin, at two suburban sacrifices one Borrowed Rank was permitted.

sentences.zh: 後親子惟注幕職，孫若庶子，兩遇郊方許奏一人，夫之親屬勿奏。

translations.literal: Later sons of the principal wife received staff posts only; grandsons or sons by concubines, only at two suburban sacrifices was one person permitted; the husband's relatives were not to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Later sons of the principal wife received staff posts only; grandsons or sons by concubines could be memorialized only at two suburban sacrifices; and the husband's relatives were not to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 舊，臣僚之妻為國夫人者，得遺表恩，後除之。

translations.literal: Formerly, wives of officials who were State Ladies received posthumous memorial favor; later this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, wives of officials who were State Ladies received posthumous memorial favor; later this was abolished.

sentences.zh: 妃嬪、公主以下，非有服親之婿不許奏。

translations.literal: Consorts, princesses, and below—sons-in-law who were not relatives within mourning were not permitted to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: For consorts, princesses, and below, sons-in-law who were not relatives within mourning were not permitted to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 既而曾布等又言：「臣僚陳請恩澤，宜有定制。」

translations.literal: Subsequently Zeng Bu and others also stated: "Officials' petitions for favor should have fixed regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently Zeng Bu and others also stated: "Officials' petitions for favor should have fixed regulations."

sentences.zh: 乃許見任二府歲乞差遣一人。

translations.literal: Thereupon incumbent Two Departments officials were permitted annually to petition for one dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon incumbent Two Departments officials were permitted annually to petition for one dispatch.

sentences.zh: 宰臣、樞密使兼平章事因事罷者，陳乞轉官一人，指射差遣二人。

translations.literal: Chief ministers and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioners concurrently Grand Councillors dismissed for cause were permitted to petition for one rank promotion and two directed dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioners concurrently Grand Councillors dismissed for cause were permitted to petition for one rank promotion and two directed dispatches.

sentences.zh: 餘執政官，並各一人。

translations.literal: Other executive officials, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: Other executive officials, each one person.

sentences.zh: 待制以上乞差遣遷學士者又一人。

translations.literal: Attendant Academicians and above who petitioned for dispatch and promotion to Academician received one additional person.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Academicians and above who petitioned for dispatch and promotion to Academician received one additional person.

sentences.zh: 三路、廣桂安撫使、知成都府、梓州差遣一人，親孫、子循一資。

translations.literal: Three-circuit and Guang-Gui pacification commissioners, prefects of Chengdu and Zizhou—one dispatch; personal grandsons and sons advanced one rank step.
translations.idiomatic: Three-circuit and Guang-Gui pacification commissioners and prefects of Chengdu and Zizhou received one dispatch; personal grandsons and sons advanced one rank step.

sentences.zh: 廣南轉運、提點刑獄奏子孫或期親合入官一人。

translations.literal: Southern Guang transport commissioners and judicial intendants memorialized one descendant or personal relative eligible for office.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Guang transport commissioners and judicial intendants memorialized one descendant or personal relative eligible for office.

sentences.zh: 成都、梓、利、夔路差遣一人，子孫循一資。

translations.literal: Chengdu, Ziz, Li, and Kui circuits—one dispatch; descendants advanced one rank step.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu, Ziz, Li, and Kui circuits received one dispatch; descendants advanced one rank step.

sentences.zh: 中書檢正官、樞密院檢詳官至員外郎，在職及二年，遇大禮許補親屬。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat examining officials and Bureau of Military Affairs reviewing officials reaching Vice Director rank, after two years in office at great sacrifice were permitted to grant privilege to relatives.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat examining officials and Bureau of Military Affairs reviewing officials reaching Vice Director rank, after two years in office at great sacrifice were permitted to grant privilege to relatives.

sentences.zh: 中書堂後官、提點五房官，雖未至員外，聽奏補。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat rear-chamber officials and supervisors of the five offices, though not yet reaching Vice Director, were permitted memorial privilege appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat rear-chamber officials and supervisors of the five offices, though not yet reaching Vice Director, were permitted memorial privilege appointment.

sentences.zh: 邕、宜、欽極邊煙瘴知州，聽奏子孫一人。

translations.literal: Prefects of Yong, Yi, and Qin on the extreme border in malarial regions were permitted to memorialize one descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects of Yong, Yi, and Qin on the extreme border in malarial regions were permitted to memorialize one descendant.

sentences.zh: 凡因戰陣物故及歿於王事，許官其子孫。

translations.literal: For all who died in battle or in service to the state, descendants were permitted office.
translations.idiomatic: For all who died in battle or in service to the state, descendants were permitted office.

sentences.zh: 又功臣繪像之家，如無食錄人，則許特奏子孫一人入官。

translations.literal: Also for families of meritorious officials with painted portraits, if none received salary registers, one descendant was permitted special memorial entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: Also for families of meritorious officials with painted portraits, if none received salary registers, one descendant was permitted special memorial entry into office.

sentences.zh: 既定《銓試法》，任子中選者得隨銓擬注，其入優等，往往特旨賜進士出身。

translations.literal: Once the 《Selection Examination Law》 was established, sons appointed by privilege who passed selection could follow selection proposal for assignment; those entering superior grade often received special edict granting Jinshi initial credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Once the 《Selection Examination Law》 was established, sons appointed by privilege who passed selection could follow selection proposal for assignment; those entering superior grade often received special edict granting Jinshi initial credentials.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年詔：「諸軍致仕停放人，其遺表恩該及子而過五年自陳者，慮有冒濫，毋推恩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou an edict stated: "For retired and discharged military personnel, if posthumous memorial favor covered sons but self-petition came after five years, fearing fraud and excess, favor shall not be extended.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanyou an edict stated: "For retired and discharged military personnel, if posthumous memorial favor covered sons but self-petition came after five years, fearing fraud and excess, favor shall not be extended.

sentences.zh: 職事官卿、監以下應任子者，須官至朝奉郎，乃許奏。」

translations.literal: Functional officials from director and supervisor downward eligible to appoint sons had to reach Court Gentleman for Court Service rank before memorializing was permitted."
translations.idiomatic: Functional officials from director and supervisor downward eligible to appoint sons had to reach Court Gentleman for Court Service rank before memorializing was permitted."

sentences.zh: 三年，定宰臣、執政初遇郊，許奏本宗異姓親各一人，次遇郊，奏數如初。

translations.literal: In the third year, it was fixed that chief ministers and executive officials at first suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative of this clan and one of different surname each; at next suburban sacrifice the number of memorializations was as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, it was fixed that chief ministers and executive officials at first suburban sacrifice were permitted to memorialize one relative of this clan and one of different surname each; at the next suburban sacrifice the number of memorializations was as before.

sentences.zh: 願用其恩與有官人，則許轉官並循資，或乞差遣，惟不得轉入朝官、循入支掌。

translations.literal: If wishing to use the favor for someone already holding office, rank promotion and rank-step advancement were permitted, or petition for dispatch—only promotion to capital court official or advancement to branch supervisor was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If wishing to use the favor for someone already holding office, rank promotion and rank-step advancement were permitted, or petition for dispatch—only promotion to capital court official or advancement to branch supervisor was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 應奏承務郎、殿直以上，許換升一任；

translations.literal: For those eligible to memorialize Court Gentleman for Attendant Service, Palace Guard, and above, exchange promotion one term was permitted;
translations.idiomatic: For those eligible to memorialize Court Gentleman for Attendant Service, Palace Guard, and above, exchange promotion one term was permitted;

sentences.zh: 不得升入通判。

translations.literal: promotion to Vice Prefect was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: but promotion to Vice Prefect was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 餘官三遇郊，許奏有官人。

translations.literal: Other officials at three suburban sacrifices were permitted to memorialize someone already holding office.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials at three suburban sacrifices were permitted to memorialize someone already holding office.

sentences.zh: 舊制，應奏兩人止者，次郊，止許奏有官人。

translations.literal: Under the old system, those permitted to memorialize two persons only—at the next suburban sacrifice, only someone already holding office was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, those permitted to memorialize two persons only—at the next suburban sacrifice, only someone already holding office was permitted.

sentences.zh: 其後，遇郊更合補蔭者，並準此為間隔之次；

translations.literal: Thereafter, those at suburban sacrifice again eligible for privilege appointment all used this as the interval sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, those at suburban sacrifice again eligible for privilege appointment all used this as the interval sequence;

sentences.zh: 已致仕而遇大禮應奏補者，再奏而止。

translations.literal: those already retired who at great sacrifice were eligible for privilege memorialization—memorialization twice only then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: those already retired who at great sacrifice were eligible for privilege memorialization could memorialize twice only.

sentences.zh: 宣仁太皇太后諭輔臣曰：「近已裁減入流，本家恩澤，宜減四分之一。」

translations.literal: Grand Empress Dowager Xuanren instructed assisting ministers: "Recently entry into office has been curtailed; favor for my own family should be reduced by one quarter."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Empress Dowager Xuanren instructed assisting ministers: "Recently entry into office has been curtailed; favor for my own family should be reduced by one quarter."

sentences.zh: 呂公著等曰：「陛下臨朝同聽斷，本殿恩澤，自不當限數。

translations.literal: Lu Gongzhu and others said: "Your Majesty attends court and jointly decides cases; favor for this palace should naturally not be limited in number.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Gongzhu and others said: "Your Majesty attends court and jointly decides cases; favor for this palace should naturally not be limited in number.

sentences.zh: 先來所定，止與皇太后同等，豈可更損？」

translations.literal: What was previously fixed was only equal to the Empress Dowager—how can it be further reduced?"
translations.idiomatic: What was previously fixed was only equal to the Empress Dowager—how can it be further reduced?"

sentences.zh: 宣仁曰：「裁減恩澤，凡自上而始，則均一矣。」

translations.literal: Xuanren said: "Curtailing favor—all beginning from above, then it is equal."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanren said: "Curtailing favor—if it begins from above, then it is equal."

sentences.zh: 乃詔曰：「官冗之患，實極於今，苟非裁入流之數，無以清取士之原。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued: "The affliction of official redundancy has truly reached its peak today; if the number entering office is not curtailed, there is no way to cleanse the source of selecting scholars.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued: "The affliction of official redundancy has truly reached its peak today; if the number entering office is not curtailed, there is no way to cleanse the source of selecting scholars.

sentences.zh: 吾以眇身率先天下，今後每遇聖節、大禮、生辰，合得親屬恩澤，並四分減一，皇太后、皇太妃同之。」

translations.literal: I with my humble person lead the world; from now on at each imperial birthday, great sacrifice, and birthday, eligible relative favor shall all be reduced by one quarter; the Empress Dowager and Grand Consort likewise."
translations.idiomatic: I with my humble person lead the world; from now on at each imperial birthday, great sacrifice, and birthday, eligible relative favor shall all be reduced by one quarter; the Empress Dowager and Grand Consort likewise."

sentences.zh: 哲宗既親政，詔復舊。

translations.literal: After Zhezong personally governed, an edict restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhezong personally governed, an edict restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 凡乞致仕而不願轉官者，中大夫至朝奉郎及諸司使，許奏補本宗有服親一人；

translations.literal: For all petitioning retirement without wishing rank promotion, Court Grandee to Court Gentleman for Court Service and bureau commissioners were permitted to memorialize privilege appointment for one relative within mourning of this clan;
translations.idiomatic: For all petitioning retirement without wishing rank promotion, Court Grandee to Court Gentleman for Court Service and bureau commissioners were permitted to memorialize privilege appointment for one relative within mourning of this clan;

sentences.zh: 自奉議郎、內殿承製以下，許與有服親一人恩例；

translations.literal: from Court Gentleman for Discussion and Inner Hall Artisan downward, one relative within mourning was permitted the favor precedent;
translations.idiomatic: from Court Gentleman for Discussion and Inner Hall Artisan downward, one relative within mourning was permitted the favor precedent;

sentences.zh: 惟中大夫、中散大夫、諸司使帶遙郡者，蔭補外仍與有服親恩例；

translations.literal: only Court Grandee, Court Gentleman for Dispersal, and bureau commissioners holding distant commandery commissions, outside privilege appointment still received the favor precedent for relatives within mourning;
translations.idiomatic: only Court Grandee, Court Gentleman for Dispersal, and bureau commissioners holding distant commandery commissions, outside privilege appointment still received the favor precedent for relatives within mourning;

sentences.zh: 若致仕未受敕而身亡者，在外以陳乞至門下省日，在京以得旨日，亦許乞有服親恩例一人。

translations.literal: if retiring without receiving edict but dying, outside the capital from the day the petition reached the Chancellery, inside the capital from the day of receiving approval, one relative within mourning favor precedent was also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: if retiring without receiving edict but dying, outside the capital from the day the petition reached the Chancellery, inside the capital from the day of receiving approval, one relative within mourning favor precedent was also permitted.

sentences.zh: 初，《任子法》以長幼為序，若應奏者有廢疾，或嘗犯私罪至徒，或不肖難任從仕，許越奏其次。

translations.literal: Initially, the 《Law for Appointing Sons》 ordered by seniority; if the eligible memorializer had disability, or had committed private offense up to penal servitude, or was unworthy and difficult to employ, memorializing the next in order was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, the 《Law for Appointing Sons》 ordered by seniority; if the eligible memorializer had disability, or had committed private offense up to penal servitude, or was unworthy and difficult to employ, memorializing the next in order was permitted.

sentences.zh: 至是，始刪去格令「長幼為序」四字。

translations.literal: At this time, the four characters "ordered by seniority" were first deleted from the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the four characters "ordered by seniority" were first deleted from the regulations.

sentences.zh: 五年，定《親王女郡主蔭補法》，遇大禮，許奏親屬一人，所生子仍與右班殿直；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the 《Law for Privilege Appointment of Imperial Princes' Daughters and Commandery Princesses》 was established; at great sacrifice one relative was permitted; sons born of the principal wife still received Right Class Palace Guard;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the 《Law for Privilege Appointment of Imperial Princes' Daughters and Commandery Princesses》 was established; at great sacrifice one relative was permitted; sons born of the principal wife still received Right Class Palace Guard;

sentences.zh: 兩遇，奏子或孫與奉職；

translations.literal: at two occasions, memorializing son or grandson for Attendant Service;
translations.idiomatic: at two occasions, memorializing son or grandson for Attendant Service;

sentences.zh: 即用奏子孫恩回授外服親之夫，及夫之有服親者，有官人轉一官，毋得升朝，選人循一資，無官者與借職，須期以下親，乃得奏。

translations.literal: the favor for memorializing descendants could be transferred to husbands of relatives outside the clan, and the husband's relatives within mourning; those with office received one rank promotion, not permitted to enter capital court rank; selection candidates advanced one rank step; those without office received Borrowed Rank; only personal relatives or closer were permitted to be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: the favor for memorializing descendants could be transferred to husbands of relatives outside the clan and the husband's relatives within mourning; those with office received one rank promotion but were not permitted to enter capital court rank; selection candidates advanced one rank step; those without office received Borrowed Rank; only personal relatives or closer were permitted to be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 吏部言：「皇太妃遇大禮，以應奏恩與其親屬，而服行不應法。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel stated: "The Grand Consort at great sacrifice, using eligible memorial favor for her relatives, but mourning conduct did not accord with law."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel stated: "The Grand Consort at great sacrifice used eligible memorial favor for her relatives, but mourning conduct did not accord with law."

sentences.zh: 詔用皇后緦麻女之子為比，補借職。

translations.literal: An edict used the precedent of the Empress's sons of daughters of fifth mourning degree, granting Borrowed Rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict used the precedent of the Empress's sons of daughters of fifth mourning degree, granting Borrowed Rank.

sentences.zh: 舊法，母後之家，十年一奏門客，而太妃未有法。

translations.literal: Under the old law, the empress's family memorialized one retainer every ten years, but the Grand Consort had no regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old law, the empress's family memorialized one retainer every ten years, but the Grand Consort had no regulation.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，詔皇太妃用興龍節奏親屬恩，回授門客。

translations.literal: In the early Shaosheng period, an edict permitted the Grand Consort to use the Xinglong Festival to memorialize relative favor, transferring it to retainers.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shaosheng period, an edict permitted the Grand Consort to use the Xinglong Festival to memorialize relative favor, transferring it to retainers.

sentences.zh: 自是，太后每及八年、太妃十年，奏門客一名，與假承務郎，許參選。

translations.literal: From this, the Empress Dowager every eight years and the Grand Consort every ten years memorialized one retainer, granting Provisional Court Gentleman for Attendant Service, permitted in selection.
translations.idiomatic: From this, the Empress Dowager every eight years and the Grand Consort every ten years memorialized one retainer, granting Provisional Court Gentleman for Attendant Service and permitting selection.

sentences.zh: 如年數未及，凡恩皆毋回授。

translations.literal: If the year count had not been reached, all favor was not to be transferred.
translations.idiomatic: If the year count had not been reached, all favor was not to be transferred.

sentences.zh: 元符後，命婦生皇子許依大禮奏有服親，三品以上三人。

translations.literal: After Yuanfu, titled ladies who bore imperial sons were permitted at great sacrifice to memorialize relatives within mourning—three persons for third rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuanfu, titled ladies who bore imperial sons were permitted at great sacrifice to memorialize relatives within mourning—three persons for third rank and above.

sentences.zh: 宗室緦麻親，許視異姓蔭孫。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen of fifth mourning degree were permitted to be treated as privilege grandsons of different surname.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen of fifth mourning degree were permitted to be treated as privilege grandsons of different surname.

sentences.zh: 凡蔭補異姓，惟執政得奏，如簽書樞密院事雖依執政法，而所蔭即不理選限。

translations.literal: For all privilege appointment of different surname, only executive officials could memorialize; such as the Bureau of Military Affairs co-signatory, though following executive regulations, those granted privilege were not subject to selection waiting limits.
translations.idiomatic: For all privilege appointment of different surname, only executive officials could memorialize; such as the Bureau of Military Affairs co-signatory, though following executive regulations, those granted privilege were not subject to selection waiting limits.

sentences.zh: 後因轉官礙止法者，許回授未仕子孫，而貪冒者又請回授異姓，有司每沮止之，然亦多御筆許特補。

translations.literal: Later because rank promotion was blocked by ceiling regulations, transfer to unappointed descendants was permitted; yet the greedy also requested transfer to different surname, and the relevant offices often obstructed this, yet many were also permitted special appointment by imperial brush.
translations.idiomatic: Later because rank promotion was blocked by ceiling regulations, transfer to unappointed descendants was permitted; yet the greedy also requested transfer to different surname, and the relevant offices often obstructed this, yet many were also permitted special appointment by imperial brush.

sentences.zh: 政和間，尚書省定《回授格》，謂無官可轉，或可轉而官高不欲轉，或事大而功效顯著為一格，許奏補內外白身有服親；

translations.literal: During the Zhenghe period, the Ministry of Personnel established the 《Transfer Regulations》, stating that having no office to promote, or being able to promote but holding high office and not wishing to, or undertaking great affairs with conspicuous merit constituted one grade, permitting memorial privilege appointment for inner and outer commoners with relatives within mourning;
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenghe period, the Ministry of Personnel established the 《Transfer Regulations》, stating that having no office to promote, or being able to promote but holding high office and not wishing to, or undertaking great affairs with conspicuous merit constituted one grade, permitting memorial privilege appointment for inner and outer commoners with relatives within mourning;

sentences.zh: 官有止法不可轉，功績次著為一格，許奏本宗白身袒免親；

translations.literal: office having ceiling regulations and unable to promote, merit secondary but notable constituted one grade, permitting memorialization of commoner shirt-sleeve mourning relatives of this clan;
translations.idiomatic: office having ceiling regulations and unable to promote, merit secondary but notable constituted one grade, permitting memorialization of commoner shirt-sleeve mourning relatives of this clan;

sentences.zh: 官不甚高、而功績大為一格，許奏本宗白身有服親；

translations.literal: office not very high but merit great constituted one grade, permitting memorialization of commoner relatives within mourning of this clan;
translations.idiomatic: office not very high but merit great constituted one grade, permitting memorialization of commoner relatives within mourning of this clan;

sentences.zh: 官不甚高、功不甚大為一格，而分為三，一與內外有官有服親，一與有官有服本宗親，一與有官有服者之子孫。

translations.literal: office not very high, merit not very great constituted one grade, divided into three: one for inner and outer officeholders with relatives within mourning, one for officeholders with relatives within mourning of this clan, one for descendants of officeholders with relatives within mourning.
translations.idiomatic: office not very high, merit not very great constituted one grade, divided into three: one for inner and outer officeholders with relatives within mourning, one for officeholders with relatives within mourning of this clan, and one for descendants of officeholders with relatives within mourning.

sentences.zh: 凡為六等。

translations.literal: In all there were six grades.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were six grades.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，殿中侍御史張汝舟言：「今法所該補奏，與先朝同。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, Palace Attendant Censor Zhang Ruzhou stated: "The memorial privilege appointments covered by current law are the same as the previous dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuanhe, Palace Attendant Censor Zhang Ruzhou stated: "The memorial privilege appointments covered by current law are the same as the previous dynasty.

sentences.zh: 昔之官至大夫，曆官不下三五十年，而今閱三五年，有已至大夫者矣；

translations.literal: Formerly reaching Court Grandee rank required no less than thirty to fifty years of service, yet now within three to five years some have already reached Court Grandee;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly reaching Court Grandee rank required no less than thirty to fifty years of service, yet now within three to five years some have already reached Court Grandee;

sentences.zh: 諸翼將軍至武翼郎，須出官三十年，方許奏補；

translations.literal: from Various-Wing General to Martial-Wing Gentleman, thirty years outside office were required before privilege memorialization was permitted;
translations.idiomatic: from Various-Wing General to Martial-Wing Gentleman, thirty years outside office were required before privilege memorialization was permitted;

sentences.zh: 今文武官奏補，未嘗限年，此太濫也。

translations.literal: now civil and military officials' privilege memorialization has never been limited by years—this is too excessive.
translations.idiomatic: now civil and military officials' privilege memorialization has never been limited by years—this is too excessive.

sentences.zh: 至若中大夫以下及武功、武翼大夫，已求致仕而不及受敕，乃格其恩，於是有身謝而未受敕者，其家或至匿哀須限；

translations.literal: As for Court Grandee and below and Martial Achievement and Martial-Wing Grandee, having petitioned retirement but not yet received edict, favor was blocked; thus some who had personally thanked the throne but not received edict—their families sometimes even concealed mourning to await the deadline;
translations.idiomatic: As for Court Grandee and below and Martial Achievement and Martial-Wing Grandee, having petitioned retirement but not yet received edict, favor was blocked; thus some who had personally thanked the throne but not received edict—their families sometimes even concealed mourning to await the deadline;

sentences.zh: 然不及親受而不與沾恩者多矣，此太吝也。

translations.literal: yet many who did not personally receive it were not granted favor—this is too stingy.
translations.idiomatic: yet many who did not personally receive it were not granted favor—this is too stingy.

sentences.zh: 欲自今中大夫至帶職朝奉郎以上，雖遇郊恩，入官不及二十年，皆未許蔭補；

translations.literal: It is desired that from now Court Grandee to Concurrent Court Gentleman for Court Service and above, though encountering suburban amnesty, if entry into office has not reached twenty years, privilege appointment is not permitted;
translations.idiomatic: It is desired that from now Court Grandee to Concurrent Court Gentleman for Court Service and above, though encountering suburban amnesty, if entry into office has not reached twenty years, privilege appointment is not permitted;

sentences.zh: 雖已經奏薦，再遇郊恩年仍未及者，亦寢其奏，庶抑其濫。

translations.literal: even if already memorialized, if at the next suburban amnesty years still have not been reached, the memorial is also suspended, perhaps restraining excess.
translations.idiomatic: even if already memorialized, if at the next suburban amnesty years still have not been reached, the memorial is also suspended, perhaps restraining excess.

sentences.zh: 至於文武官及大夫以上嘗求休致，而身謝在出敕前，欲並許奏蔭，以補其不及。」

translations.literal: As for civil and military officials and Grandee and above who once petitioned retirement but personal thanks came before edict issuance, it is desired to permit privilege memorialization together, to remedy what was not reached."
translations.idiomatic: As for civil and military officials and Grandee and above who once petitioned retirement but personal thanks came before edict issuance, it is desired to permit privilege memorialization together, to remedy what was not reached."

sentences.zh: 尚書省文武官致仕，雖不及受敕，若無曾受蔭人，自有遺表恩。
