translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel stated: civil and military officials retiring, though not receiving edict, if none had received privilege appointment, still had posthumous memorial favor.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel stated: civil and military officials retiring, though not receiving edict, if none had received privilege appointment, still had posthumous memorial favor.

sentences.zh: 又寺、監長貳至開封少尹，係用職事蔭補，不合限年。

translations.literal: Also directors and vice directors of courts and directorates to Kaifeng Junior Prefect used functional privilege appointment and did not fit the year limit.
translations.idiomatic: Also directors and vice directors of courts and directorates to Kaifeng Junior Prefect used functional privilege appointment and did not fit the year limit.

sentences.zh: 餘從之。

translations.literal: The remainder was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder was approved.

sentences.zh: 崇寧以來，類多泛賞，如曰「應奉有勞」、「獻頌可采」、「職事修舉」，特授特轉者，皆無事狀可名，而直以與之。

translations.literal: Since the Chongning period, favors were broadly granted, such as claims of "merit in imperial service," "panegyrics worth adopting," and "duties well performed"; those specially appointed or specially promoted had no service record to name, yet were granted directly.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Chongning period, favors were broadly granted under labels such as "merit in imperial service," "panegyrics worth adopting," and "duties well performed"; those specially appointed or specially promoted had no service record to cite, yet were granted directly.

sentences.zh: 孟昌齡、朱勔父子、童貫、梁師成、李邦彥等，凡所請求皆有定價，故不三五年，選人有至正郎或員外，帶職小使臣至正、副使或入遙郡橫行者。

translations.literal: Meng Changling, Zhu Mian and his son, Tong Guan, Liang Shicheng, Li Bangyan, and the like—all their requests had fixed prices; thus within three to five years selection candidates reached Forward Director or Vice Director, minor envoys with concurrent posts reached chief or vice commissioner, or entered distant prefectures by lateral appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Changling, Zhu Mian and his son, Tong Guan, Liang Shicheng, Li Bangyan, and the like—all their requests had fixed prices; thus within three to five years candidates reached Forward Director or Vice Director, minor envoys with concurrent posts reached chief or vice commissioner, or entered distant prefectures by lateral appointment.

sentences.zh: 而蔡京拔用從官，不論途轍，一言合意，即日持橐。

translations.literal: Cai Jing promoted attendants without regard to route; if one remark pleased him, that same day one received bag-bearing attendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing promoted attendants without regard to the usual path; if one remark pleased him, that same day one received bag-bearing attendant rank.

sentences.zh: 又優堂吏，往往至中奉大夫，或換防禦、觀察使。

translations.literal: He also favored hall clerks, who often reached Grandee for Court Audience, or were exchanged for defense commissioner or surveillance commissioner posts.
translations.idiomatic: He also favored hall clerks, who often reached Grandee for Court Audience or were exchanged for defense commissioner or surveillance commissioner posts.

sentences.zh: 由此任子百倍。

translations.literal: From this, sons appointed by privilege increased a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: From this, sons appointed by privilege increased a hundredfold.

sentences.zh: 欽宗即位，赦恩覃轉，惟許宗室；

translations.literal: When Qinzong ascended the throne, amnesty favor extended broadly in rank promotion, permitted only for the imperial clan;
translations.idiomatic: When Qinzong ascended the throne, amnesty favor extended broadly in rank promotion, permitted only for the imperial clan;

sentences.zh: 其文武臣止令回授有官有服親，且詔：「非法應回授及特許者，毋錄用。」

translations.literal: civil and military officials were ordered to grant privilege only to kin already holding office and within mourning, and an edict stated: "Those not legally eligible for privilege grant or special permission shall not be recorded for appointment."
translations.idiomatic: civil and military officials were ordered to grant privilege only to kin already holding office and within mourning, and an edict stated: "Those not legally eligible for privilege grant or special permission shall not be recorded for appointment."

sentences.zh: 高宗中興，重定《補蔭法》，內外臣僚子孫期親大功以下及異姓親隨，文武各有等秩，見《職官志》。

translations.literal: At Gaozong's restoration, the 《Privilege Appointment Law》 was re-established; for inner and outer officials' descendants, personal relatives and second mourning degree and below and different-surname kin followers, civil and military each had graded ranks—see the 《Treatise on Offices》.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaozong's restoration, the 《Privilege Appointment Law》 was re-established; for inner and outer officials' descendants, personal relatives and second mourning degree and below and different-surname kin followers, civil and military each had graded ranks—see the 《Treatise on Offices》.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年，詔：「宰執子弟以恩澤任待制以上者，並罷。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyan, an edict stated: "Sons and younger brothers of chief ministers and executive officials appointed through favor to Attendant Academician and above are all dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianyan, an edict stated: "Sons and younger brothers of chief ministers and executive officials appointed through favor to Attendant Academician and above are all dismissed."

sentences.zh: 紹興四年詔：「文武太中大夫以上及見帶兩製職名，依舊不限年。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxing an edict stated: "Civil and military Grandee of Palace Service and above and those currently holding dual-academician titles, as before are not limited by years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxing an edict stated: "Civil and military Grandee of Palace Service and above and those currently holding dual-academician titles, as before are not limited by years.

sentences.zh: 內無出身自授官後以及十五年，年及三十、不係宮觀責降之人，聽依條補蔭。」

translations.literal: Within, those without initial credentials from self-appointment reaching fifteen years, age reaching thirty, not subject to palace or temple demotion, were permitted privilege appointment according to regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Within, those without initial credentials from self-appointment reaching fifteen years, age reaching thirty, not subject to palace or temple demotion, were permitted privilege appointment according to regulations."

sentences.zh: 七年，中書舍人趙思誠言：「孤寒之士，名在選部，皆待數年之闕，大率十年不得一任。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Secretariat Drafter Zhao Sicheng stated: "Isolated and poor scholars, named in the selection department, all await vacancies for several years; generally ten years without one appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Secretariat Drafter Zhao Sicheng stated: "Isolated and poor scholars, named in the selection department, all await vacancies for several years; generally ten years without one appointment.

sentences.zh: 今親祠之歲，任子約四千人，是十年之後，增萬二千員，科舉取士不與焉。

translations.literal: Now in years of personal sacrifice, sons appointed by privilege number about four thousand; in ten years this adds twelve thousand posts, not counting examination-selected scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Now in years of personal sacrifice, sons appointed by privilege number about four thousand; in ten years this adds twelve thousand posts, not counting examination-selected scholars.

sentences.zh: 將見寒士有三十年不得調者矣。

translations.literal: We will see poor scholars unable to receive appointment for thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: We will see poor scholars unable to receive appointment for thirty years.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時，仕至卿、監者，皆實以年勞、功績得之，年必六十，身不過得恩澤五六人。

translations.literal: In the time of the founding emperors, reaching director and supervisor rank was truly gained through years of service and merit; age had to be sixty; in one's lifetime one received favor for only five or six persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of the founding emperors, reaching director and supervisor rank was truly gained through years of service and merit; age had to be sixty; in one's lifetime one received favor for only five or six persons.

sentences.zh: 厥後私謁行，橫恩廣，有年未三十而官至大夫者，員數比祖宗時不知其幾倍，而恩例未嘗少損。

translations.literal: Afterward private solicitation flourished and favor spread broadly; some not yet thirty reached Court Grandee rank; the number of posts compared to the founding emperors' time was unknown how many times greater, yet favor precedents were never slightly reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward private solicitation flourished and favor spread broadly; some not yet thirty reached Court Grandee rank; the number of posts compared to the founding emperors' time was unknown how many times greater, yet favor precedents were never slightly reduced.

sentences.zh: 有一人而任子至十餘者，此而不革，實蠹政事，望議革其弊。」

translations.literal: Some one person appointed by privilege reached more than ten—if this is not reformed, it truly corrupts governance; I hope reform of its abuses will be discussed."
translations.idiomatic: Some one person appointed by privilege reached more than ten—if this is not reformed, it truly corrupts governance; I hope reform of its abuses will be discussed."

sentences.zh: 會思誠去國，議遂格。

translations.literal: When Sicheng left the capital, the discussion was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: When Sicheng left the capital, the discussion was shelved.

sentences.zh: 舊法，惟贓罪不許任子，新令並及私罪徒，有司以為拘礙者多，遂罷新令。

translations.literal: Under the old law, only corruption offenses did not permit appointing sons; the new order also included private offenses to penal servitude; the relevant offices considered the restrictions too numerous and abolished the new order.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old law, only corruption offenses did not permit appointing sons; the new order also included private offenses to penal servitude; the relevant offices considered the restrictions too numerous and abolished the new order.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「宰執、侍從致仕遺表，惟補緦麻以上親，毋及異姓。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Chief ministers and executive officials and attendants retiring—posthumous memorials grant privilege only to fifth mourning degree or closer relatives, not extending to different surname."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Chief ministers and executive officials and attendants retiring—posthumous memorials grant privilege only to fifth mourning degree or closer relatives, not extending to different surname."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以武臣多出軍中，爵秩高而族姓少，凡有薦奏，同姓皆期功，異姓皆中表，閭巷之徒附會以進。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because military officials mostly came from the army, rank was high but clan was small—for all memorial recommendations, same surname were all personal and second mourning degree, different surname were all maternal kin; alley folk attached themselves to advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, because military officials mostly came from the army, rank was high but clan was small—for all memorial recommendations, same surname were all personal and second mourning degree, different surname were all maternal kin; alley folk attached themselves to advance.

sentences.zh: 命須經統轄長官結罪保明，詭冒者連坐之。

translations.literal: It was ordered that supervising commanders must certify under oath; fraudsters were punished by association.
translations.idiomatic: It was ordered that supervising commanders must certify under oath; fraudsters were punished by association.

sentences.zh: 帝於后妃補蔭，每加裁抑，詔後族不得任從官。

translations.literal: The emperor toward consorts' privilege appointment always added restraint; an edict stated that empress's kin could not hold attendant posts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor toward consorts' privilege appointment always added restraint; an edict stated that empress's kin could not hold attendant posts.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，思革冗官。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, he sought to reform redundant offices.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong ascended the throne, he sought to reform redundant offices.

sentences.zh: 初詔百官任子遇郊恩權免奏薦，年七十人，遇郊不許奏子。

translations.literal: Initially an edict exempted all officials from memorializing sons at suburban amnesty; persons aged seventy were not permitted to memorialize sons at suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At first an edict exempted all officials from memorializing sons at suburban amnesty, and persons aged seventy were not permitted to memorialize sons at suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 俄又詔，未奏者許一名。

translations.literal: Soon another edict permitted one person for those who had not yet memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Soon another edict permitted one person for those who had not yet memorialized.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，以張宋卿言蔭補冗濫，立為定法。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, on Zhang Songqing's statement that privilege appointment was redundant and excessive, fixed regulations were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longxing, after Zhang Songqing said privilege appointment had become redundant and excessive, fixed regulations were established.

sentences.zh: 凡員外轉正郎，正郎轉侍從，卿監之至中大夫，每初遇郊，則聽任一子；

translations.literal: For all who advanced from Vice Director to Forward Director, Forward Director to attendant, and from director and supervisor up to Court Grandee, at the first suburban sacrifice one son was permitted;
translations.idiomatic: For all who advanced from Vice Director to Forward Director, from Forward Director to attendant, and from director and supervisor up to Court Grandee, at the first suburban sacrifice one son was permitted;

sentences.zh: 再經，則不許復請。

translations.literal: after a second occasion, re-petition was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: after a second occasion, re-petition was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 遺表之恩，各減其一。

translations.literal: Posthumous memorial favor was in each case reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous memorial favor was in each case reduced by one.

sentences.zh: 減年之類，亦去其半。

translations.literal: Categories with reduced years likewise had half removed.
translations.idiomatic: Categories with reduced years likewise had half removed.

sentences.zh: 至府史之屬，武功之等，亦仿此差降之。

translations.literal: As for prefectural clerks and the like, and Martial Achievement ranks and the like, reductions followed this pattern as well.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural clerks and Martial Achievement ranks and the like also followed this pattern of graded reduction.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年詔：「非泛補官，如宗室、戚裏女夫捧香，異姓上書獻頌，隨奉使補官，陣亡女夫，異姓給使減年之類，轉至合奏薦官，候致仕與奏一名，嘗奏者不再奏。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiandao an edict stated: "For non-general supplemental appointments, such as imperial clansmen, maternal kin sons-in-law bearing incense, different-surname memorial presenters offering panegyrics, accompanying envoys receiving appointment, sons-in-law of those killed in battle, different-surname attendants with reduced years, and the like—when promoted to ranks eligible for memorial recommendation, upon retirement one person may be memorialized; those already memorialized may not be memorialized again."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiandao an edict stated: "For non-general supplemental appointments, such as imperial clansmen, maternal kin sons-in-law bearing incense, different-surname memorial presenters offering panegyrics, accompanying envoys receiving appointment, sons-in-law of those killed in battle, different-surname attendants with reduced years, and the like—when promoted to ranks eligible for memorial recommendation, upon retirement one person may be memorialized; those already memorialized may not be memorialized again."

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「宗室袒免親諸衛將軍、武功大夫至武翼郎以上，遇大禮奏補親屬，並依外官法，著為令。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict stated: "Imperial clansmen in shirt-sleeve mourning, generals of the various guards, Martial Achievement Grandee to Martial-Wing Gentleman and above—at great sacrifice memorializing relatives for privilege appointment—all follow outer-official regulations, established as fixed order."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict stated: "Imperial clansmen in shirt-sleeve mourning, generals of the various guards, Martial Achievement Grandee to Martial-Wing Gentleman and above—at great sacrifice memorializing relatives for privilege appointment—all follow outer-official regulations, established as fixed order."

sentences.zh: 九年，詔：「文臣帶職員外郎及武翼大夫以上，生前未嘗奏薦者，與致仕恩澤一名；

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict stated: "Civil officials holding concurrent Vice Director rank and Martial-Wing Grandee and above who in life had never memorialized for recommendation received one retirement favor;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, an edict stated: "Civil officials holding concurrent Vice Director rank and Martial-Wing Grandee and above who in life had never memorialized for recommendation received one retirement favor;

sentences.zh: 即已嘗奏薦而被蔭人身亡，許再請。

translations.literal: if already memorialized but the person granted privilege died, re-petition was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: if already memorialized but the person granted privilege died, re-petition was permitted.

sentences.zh: 應朝奉郎、武翼郎以上補授及三十年者，亦與一名。」

translations.literal: Those eligible from Court Gentleman for Court Service and Martial-Wing Gentleman and above with privilege appointment reaching thirty years also received one person."
translations.idiomatic: Those eligible from Court Gentleman for Court Service and Martial-Wing Gentleman and above with privilege appointment reaching thirty years also received one person."

sentences.zh: 又詔：「武臣嘗任執政官，遇郊聽補文資。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Military officials who once served as executive officials, at suburban sacrifice were permitted civil rank privilege appointment."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Military officials who once served as executive officials, at suburban sacrifice were permitted civil rank privilege appointment."

sentences.zh: 於是恩數視執政者亦得之。

translations.literal: Thereupon favor counts equal to executive officials were also obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon favor counts equal to executive officials were also obtained.

sentences.zh: 蓋戚裏、宗王與夫攀附之臣，皆爭以文資祿其子，不可復正矣。

translations.literal: For maternal kin, imperial princes, and their attached officials all competed to grant civil rank salaries to their sons—the situation could no longer be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: For maternal kin, imperial princes, and their attached officials all competed to grant civil rank salaries to their sons—the situation could no longer be corrected.

sentences.zh: 自隆興著酬賞實曆對用轉官之法，遷官稍緩。

translations.literal: Since Longxing established the method of matching rank promotion to reward service records, rank advancement was somewhat slowed.
translations.idiomatic: Since Longxing established the method of matching rank promotion to reward service records, rank advancement was somewhat slowed.

sentences.zh: 至是，郊恩之奏視為減半，然猶未大艾也。

translations.literal: At this time, suburban amnesty memorializations were regarded as halved, yet the problem was still not greatly remedied.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, suburban amnesty memorializations were regarded as halved, yet the problem was still not greatly remedied.

sentences.zh: 淳熙九年，始詔：「減任子員數。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chunxi, an edict was first issued: "Reduce the quota for sons appointed by privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Chunxi, an edict was first issued: "Reduce the quota for sons appointed by privilege.

sentences.zh: 自宰相、執政、侍從、卿監、正郎、員外郎，分為五等，每等降殺，以兩酌中定為止數，武臣如之。

translations.literal: From chief ministers, executive officials, attendants, directors and supervisors, Forward Directors, and Vice Directors, divided into five grades, each grade reduced, taking the midpoint of two reductions as the fixed quota; military officials likewise.
translations.idiomatic: From chief ministers, executive officials, attendants, directors and supervisors, Forward Directors, and Vice Directors, divided into five grades, each grade reduced, taking the midpoint of two reductions as the fixed quota; military officials likewise.

sentences.zh: 宰相十人，執政八人，侍從六人，中散大夫至中大夫四人，帶職朝奉郎至朝議大夫三人，通減三分之一。」

translations.literal: Chief ministers ten persons, executive officials eight, attendants six, Court Gentleman for Dispersal to Court Grandee four, Concurrent Court Gentleman for Court Service to Court Gentleman for Discussion three—in all reduced by one third."
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers ten persons, executive officials eight, attendants six, Court Gentleman for Dispersal to Court Grandee four, Concurrent Court Gentleman for Court Service to Court Gentleman for Discussion three—in all reduced by one third."

sentences.zh: 於是冗濫漸革。

translations.literal: Thereupon redundancy and excess were gradually reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon redundancy and excess were gradually reformed.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元中，立《補蔭新格》，自使相以下有差，文臣中大夫、武臣防禦使以下，不許遺表推恩。

translations.literal: During Ningzong's Qingyuan period, the 《New Regulations for Privilege Appointment》 were established; from commissioners with military commissions downward there were gradations; civil Court Grandee and military defense commissioners and below were not permitted posthumous memorial favor extension.
translations.idiomatic: During Ningzong's Qingyuan period, the 《New Regulations for Privilege Appointment》 were established; from commissioners with military commissions downward there were gradations; civil Court Grandee and military defense commissioners and below were not permitted posthumous memorial favor extension.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰初，以官冗恩濫，凡宗女夫授官者，依舊法終身止任一子，兩府使相不得以郊恩奏門客，著為令。

translations.literal: In the early Jiatai period, because of official redundancy and excessive favor, all sons-in-law of imperial clanswomen receiving office, following old law, in a lifetime could appoint only one son; Two Departments commissioners with military commissions could not memorialize retainers at suburban amnesty, established as fixed order.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Jiatai period, because of official redundancy and excessive favor, all sons-in-law of imperial clanswomen receiving office, following old law, in a lifetime could appoint only one son; Two Departments commissioners with military commissions could not memorialize retainers at suburban amnesty, established as fixed order.

sentences.zh: 凡流外補選，五省、御史臺、九寺、三監、金吾司、四方館職掌，每歲遣近臣與判銓曹，就尚書同試律三道，中者補正名，理勞考。

translations.literal: For all stream-outside supplemental selection, functionaries of the Five Departments, Censorate, Nine Courts, Three Directorates, Golden Guard Bureau, and Four Directions Hall—each year a court intimate and the selection board judge were dispatched to the Ministry of Personnel to jointly examine three legal questions; those passing received regular appointment and service credit.
translations.idiomatic: For all stream-outside supplemental selection, functionaries of the Five Departments, Censorate, Nine Courts, Three Directorates, Golden Guard Bureau, and Four Directions Hall—each year a court intimate and the selection board judge were dispatched to the Ministry of Personnel to jointly examine three legal questions; those passing received regular appointment and service credit.

sentences.zh: 三館、秘閣楷書，皆本司試書劄，中書覆試，補受。

translations.literal: Regular script copyists of the Three Halls and Secret Archive—all were examined in document writing by their own bureau, re-examined by the Central Secretariat, and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Regular script copyists of the Three Halls and Secret Archive were all examined in document writing by their own bureau, re-examined by the Central Secretariat, and appointed.

sentences.zh: 後以就試多懷挾傳授，乃鎖院、巡搜、糊名。

translations.literal: Later because examinees often carried hidden texts for instruction, the examination hall was locked, searches conducted, and names sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Later because examinees often carried hidden texts for instruction, the examination hall was locked, searches were conducted, and names were sealed.

sentences.zh: 凡試百司吏人，問律及疏，既考合格，復令口誦所對，以妨其弊。

translations.literal: For all examinations of bureau clerks, legal codes and commentaries were questioned; after passing examination, they were again ordered to recite orally their answers, to prevent fraud.
translations.idiomatic: For all examinations of bureau clerks, legal codes and commentaries were questioned; after passing examination, they were again ordered to recite orally their answers, to prevent fraud.

sentences.zh: 其自敘勞績，臣僚為之陳請，特免口誦，謂之「優試」。

translations.literal: Those who narrated their own service merit with officials petitioning on their behalf were specially exempted from oral recitation—called "preferential examination."
translations.idiomatic: Those who narrated their own service merit with officials petitioning on their behalf were specially exempted from oral recitation—called "preferential examination."

sentences.zh: 得優試者，率中選。

translations.literal: Those receiving preferential examination generally passed selection.
translations.idiomatic: Those receiving preferential examination generally passed selection.

sentences.zh: 後遂考試百司人，歲以二十人為額，毋得僥幸求優試。

translations.literal: Later bureau personnel examinations were fixed at twenty persons per year; seeking preferential examination by chance was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Later bureau personnel examinations were fixed at twenty persons per year; seeking preferential examination by chance was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 為職掌者，皆限年，授外州司戶、勒留，有至諸衛長吏、兩省主事者。

translations.literal: Functionaries all had year limits, granted outer-prefecture revenue officer or detained-in-post appointments, some reaching chief clerks of the various guards or chief clerks of the Two Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Functionaries all had year limits, granted outer-prefecture revenue officer or detained-in-post appointments, some reaching chief clerks of the various guards or chief clerks of the Two Departments.

sentences.zh: 學士、審官、審刑院，登聞檢鼓院，糾察刑獄司，皆選取諸司吏人，或以年限，或理本司選。

translations.literal: The Hanlin Academy, Review Office, Court of Judicial Review, Petition and Drum Inspection Office, and Judicial Inspection Bureau all selected bureau clerks, either by year limit or by their own bureau's selection seniority.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy, Review Office, Court of Judicial Review, Petition and Drum Inspection Office, and Judicial Inspection Bureau all selected bureau clerks, either by year limit or by their own bureau's selection seniority.

sentences.zh: 然中書制敕及五院員闕，多即遣官特試書劄，驗視材質。

translations.literal: Yet for Central Secretariat edict drafting and the five halls' vacancies, officials were often specially dispatched to examine document writing and assess talent.
translations.idiomatic: Yet for Central Secretariat edict drafting and the five halls' vacancies, officials were often specially dispatched to examine document writing and assess talent.

sentences.zh: 制敕院須堂後官以下親屬，五院須父祖有官者，樞密院亦如之，惟本院試驗。

translations.literal: The Edict Drafting Office required relatives of rear-chamber officials and below; the five halls required fathers or grandfathers holding office; the Bureau of Military Affairs likewise, examined only by its own bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Edict Drafting Office required relatives of rear-chamber officials and below; the five halls required fathers or grandfathers holding office; the Bureau of Military Affairs likewise, examined only by its own bureau.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院、三司、各省、閣門、三班院，皆本司召補，至其首者出職。

translations.literal: The Palace Domestic Service Bureau, Three Departments, various departments, Gate Office, and Third Class Court all recruited and supplemented within their own bureaus; the senior-most exited to office.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Domestic Service Bureau, Three Departments, various departments, Gate Office, and Third Class Court all recruited and supplemented within their own bureaus; the senior-most exited to office.

sentences.zh: 凡出職者，樞密院、三司，皆補借職以上，餘或補州縣。

translations.literal: For all exiting to office, the Bureau of Military Affairs and Three Departments all received Borrowed Rank and above; others received prefecture or county posts.
translations.idiomatic: For all exiting to office, the Bureau of Military Affairs and Three Departments all received Borrowed Rank and above; others received prefecture or county posts.

sentences.zh: 內廷諸司主吏、三司大將，亦有補三班借職者。

translations.literal: Chief clerks of inner court bureaus and Three Departments great captains also sometimes received Third Class Borrowed Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks of inner court bureaus and Three Departments great captains also sometimes received Third Class Borrowed Rank.

sentences.zh: 中書主事以下，三司勾覆官以上，各帶諸州上佐；

translations.literal: Central Secretariat chief clerks and below, Three Departments audit officials and above, each held senior assistant posts of various prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat chief clerks and below, Three Departments audit officials and above, each held senior assistant posts of various prefectures;

sentences.zh: 樞密院主事以上，皆帶同正將軍；

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs chief clerks and above all held Regular General rank;
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Military Affairs chief clerks and above all held Regular General rank;

sentences.zh: 餘多帶遠地司戶、簿、尉。

translations.literal: others mostly held distant revenue officer, recorder, or captain posts.
translations.idiomatic: others mostly held distant revenue officer, recorder, or captain posts.

sentences.zh: 先是，勒留、出官及選限，皆無定制。

translations.literal: Previously, detention-in-post, exit to office, and selection limits all had no fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, detention-in-post, exit to office, and selection limits all had no fixed regulations.

sentences.zh: 其隸近司，有才三二年即堂除外官者。

translations.literal: Those subordinate to nearby bureaus, some after only two or three years received direct court appointment as outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: Those subordinate to nearby bureaus, some after only two or three years received direct court appointment as outer officials.

sentences.zh: 咸平末，命翰林學士承旨宋白，與兩製、御史中丞同詳定之。

translations.literal: At the end of Xianping, Hanlin Academician Grandee Song Bai was ordered, together with dual academicians and the Vice Censor-in-Chief, to examine and fix regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xianping, Hanlin Academician Grandee Song Bai was ordered, together with dual academicians and the Vice Censor-in-Chief, to examine and fix regulations.

sentences.zh: 白等請令「中書沿堂五院行首、副行首，依舊制補三班；

translations.literal: Bai and others requested that "Central Secretariat corridor five halls senior clerks and deputy senior clerks, following old regulations, receive Third Class appointment;
translations.idiomatic: Bai and others requested that "Central Secretariat corridor five halls senior clerks and deputy senior clerks, following old regulations, receive Third Class appointment;

sentences.zh: 通引、堂門、直省、發敕驗使臣，遇闕，依名次補正名；

translations.literal: guidance ushers, hall gatekeepers, direct provincial clerks, and edict-dispatching envoys—when vacancies occurred, received regular appointment by seniority;
translations.idiomatic: guidance ushers, hall gatekeepers, direct provincial clerks, and edict-dispatching envoys—when vacancies occurred, received regular appointment by seniority;

sentences.zh: 三年授勒留官，遇恩則一年，授後，七年出官。

translations.literal: after three years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty one year; after grant, seven years to exit to office.
translations.idiomatic: after three years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty one year; after grant, seven years to exit to office.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院貼房至都勾押官，軍將至知客、押衙各六等，並以次補；

translations.literal: Palace Domestic Service Bureau attached offices to chief custody officers, military officers to reception and escort officers—each six grades, all supplemented in order;
translations.idiomatic: Palace Domestic Service Bureau attached offices to chief custody officers, military officers to reception and escort officers—each six grades, all supplemented in order;

sentences.zh: 至勾押官、押衙，及五年以上出官，補三班或簿、尉。

translations.literal: reaching custody officers and escort officers, after five years or more exiting to office, receiving Third Class or recorder or captain appointment.
translations.idiomatic: reaching custody officers and escort officers, after five years or more exiting to office, receiving Third Class or recorder or captain appointment.

sentences.zh: 學士院孔目官，補正三年授勒留官，遇恩一年，授後，五年出官；

translations.literal: Hanlin Academy chief clerks, after three years regular appointment granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty one year; after grant, five years to exit to office;
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academy chief clerks, after three years regular appointment granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty one year; after grant, five years to exit to office;

sentences.zh: 驅使官，補正四年授勒留官，遇恩二年，授後，八年出官。

translations.literal: attendant officers, after four years regular appointment granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, eight years to exit to office.
translations.idiomatic: attendant officers, after four years regular appointment granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, eight years to exit to office.

sentences.zh: 三館孔目官，書直庫表奏、守當官，四年授勒留官，遇恩二年，授後，守當官八年、書直庫表奏官七年、孔目官六年出職；

translations.literal: Three Halls chief clerks, document registry memorial clerks, and duty officers—four years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, duty officers eight years, document registry memorial clerks seven years, chief clerks six years to exit to office;
translations.idiomatic: Three Halls chief clerks, document registry memorial clerks, and duty officers—four years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, duty officers eight years, document registry memorial clerks seven years, chief clerks six years to exit to office;

sentences.zh: 其職遷補者，許通計年考，有奉錢官者，更留三年。

translations.literal: those promoted and supplemented in post were permitted to count years of service together; those holding salaried posts remained three more years.
translations.idiomatic: those promoted and supplemented in post were permitted to count years of service together; those holding salaried posts remained three more years.

sentences.zh: 典書、楷書五選集，準格三館入流，歲數已少，無得以諸色優勞減選。

translations.literal: Archive and regular script copyists at five selection assemblies, by regulation entering office through the Three Halls—the years were already few; reduction of selection by various preferential service credits was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Archive and regular script copyists at five selection assemblies, by regulation entering office through the Three Halls—the years were already few; reduction of selection by various preferential service credits was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 閣門、客省、承受、驅使官轉次第，並依本司舊例補正名，四年授勒留官，遇恩則二年，授後，七年出授簿、尉；

translations.literal: Gate Office, Reception Bureau, reception, and attendant officers advancing in sequence—all following their bureau's old precedent received regular appointment; four years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, seven years to exit receiving recorder or captain appointment;
translations.idiomatic: Gate Office, Reception Bureau, reception, and attendant officers advancing in sequence—all following their bureau's old precedent received regular appointment; four years granted detained-in-post office; at amnesty two years; after grant, seven years to exit receiving recorder or captain appointment;

sentences.zh: 其行首並如舊制。

translations.literal: senior clerks all followed old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Senior clerks all followed old regulations.

sentences.zh: 審刑院本無職掌名額，於諸司選差正名，令不以有無勒留。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review originally had no functionary quota; regular appointees were selected from various bureaus, ordered regardless of whether detained-in-post.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review originally had no functionary quota; regular appointees were selected from various bureaus, ordered regardless of whether detained-in-post.

sentences.zh: 審官五年、審刑三年，出官以前，諸司請自今勒留，並比七選集授官例，赴選日不以州縣地望為資敘。」

translations.literal: Review Office five years, Court of Judicial Review three years before exit to office—various bureaus requested that from now detention-in-post follow the seven-selection-assembly appointment precedent; upon going to selection, prefecture and county prestige was not used for rank ordering."
translations.idiomatic: Review Office five years, Court of Judicial Review three years before exit to office—various bureaus requested that from now detention-in-post follow the seven-selection-assembly appointment precedent; upon going to selection, prefecture and county prestige was not used for rank ordering."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 後又定客省承受、行首歲滿補殿直、奉職；

translations.literal: Later it was also fixed that Reception Bureau reception officers and senior clerks upon completing years received Palace Guard or Attendant Service appointment;
translations.idiomatic: Later it was also fixed that Reception Bureau reception officers and senior clerks upon completing years received Palace Guard or Attendant Service appointment;

sentences.zh: 御書院、翰林待詔、書藝祗候，十年以上無犯者聽出職。

translations.literal: Imperial Calligraphy Academy, Hanlin awaiting-edict officers, and calligraphy attendants—those without offense for ten years or more were permitted to exit to office.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Calligraphy Academy, Hanlin awaiting-edict officers, and calligraphy attendants—those without offense for ten years or more were permitted to exit to office.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘗親閱諸司流外人，勒之歸農者四百人。

translations.literal: Taizu once personally reviewed stream-outside personnel of various bureaus and compelled four hundred to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu once personally reviewed stream-outside personnel of various bureaus and compelled four hundred to return to farming.

sentences.zh: 開寶間，詔：「流外選人經十考入令、錄者，引對，方得注擬。

translations.literal: During the Kaibao period, an edict stated: "Stream-outside selection candidates who through ten examinations reached Magistrate or Recorder rank, upon audience presentation, then received appointment proposal.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaibao period, an edict stated: "Stream-outside selection candidates who through ten examinations reached Magistrate or Recorder rank, upon audience presentation, then received appointment proposal.

sentences.zh: 驅使散從官、伎術人，資考雖多，亦不注擬。」

translations.literal: Attendant and scattered follower officers and skilled artisans, though service credit was great, also did not receive appointment proposal."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant and scattered follower officers and skilled artisans, though service credit was great, also did not receive appointment proposal."

sentences.zh: 堂後官多為奸髒，欲更用士之在令、錄、簿、尉選者充之；

translations.literal: Rear-chamber officials were often corrupt; it was desired to replace them with scholars on the Magistrate, Recorder, Chief Clerk, and Captain selection rolls;
translations.idiomatic: Rear-chamber officials were often corrupt; it was desired to replace them with scholars on the Magistrate, Recorder, Chief Clerk, and Captain selection rolls;

sentences.zh: 或不屑就，而所選不及數，乃如舊制。

translations.literal: some disdained to take the posts, and those selected did not reach the quota; thus the old system continued.
translations.idiomatic: some disdained to take the posts, and those selected did not reach the quota; thus the old system continued.

sentences.zh: 雍熙時，以堂後官充職事官，入謝外不赴朝參，見宰相禮同胥吏。

translations.literal: During Yongxi, rear-chamber officials served as functional officials; except for entry to give thanks they did not attend court audience; meeting chief ministers their ritual was the same as clerks.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi, rear-chamber officials served as functional officials; except for entry to give thanks they did not attend court audience; when meeting chief ministers their ritual was the same as clerks.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，以河南府法曹參軍梁正辭、楚丘縣主簿喬蔚等五人為將作監丞，充中書堂後官，拔選人授京官為堂吏，自此始。

translations.literal: In the early Duan Gong period, Liang Zhengci, Legal Officer of Henan Prefecture, Qiao Wei, Chief Clerk of Chuqiu County, and three others were appointed Vice Directors of the Directorate of Palace Buildings to serve as Central Secretariat rear-chamber officials—selecting candidates and granting capital official posts as hall clerks began from this.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Duan Gong period, Liang Zhengci, Legal Officer of Henan Prefecture, Qiao Wei, Chief Clerk of Chuqiu County, and three others were appointed Vice Directors of the Directorate of Palace Buildings to serve as Central Secretariat rear-chamber officials—selecting candidates and granting capital official posts as hall clerks began from this.
